Experiência com arquitetura no Flutter (Clean Architecture, MVVM, etc.).
Implementação de Design System proprietário, componentes reutilizáveis, tematização
Conhecimento de Firebase (Crashlytics, Analytics, Remote Config, Push).
Experiência com CI/CD mobile (Fastlane, Bitrise, GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps).
Noções de observabilidade e monitoramento em apps.
Experiência com app em produção (mesmo que em menor escala).

Além de trabalhar no maior grupo de moda do Brasil, focado em impulsionar talentos e especializado em fazer gigante, por aqui você também ganha:

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (apólice coletiva opcional);

Day-off no seu aniversário para você curtir muito;
Formato híbrido, para você trabalhar de onde quiser;
Até 50% de desconto nas nossas marcas;

PLR, de acordo com a nossa política;
Vagas de estacionamento e van no fim do dia, para te levar até o metrô mais próximo;

description:

​Impacto Real: Você ajuda profissionais a mudarem de patamar no mercado financeiro.

​Ambiente Ágil: Liberdade para testar novos scripts e abordagens.
​Remuneração Atrativa: Fixo + Variável agressivo baseado em:
​Reuniões qualificadas comparecidas;
​Permance geral da agenda.

​Se você quer fechar vendas, prefere um ritmo lento ou não gosta de metas diárias... esta vaga não é para você.

A Dermage é sinônimo de qualidade e cuidado. Cuidado ao cuidar da pele de verdade, com ativos de alta concentração. Cuidado ao pensar e desenvolver produtos para a pele brasileira há 30 anos, criando fórmulas nas mais variadas texturas e para suas diversas necessidades.

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Agoda is looking for a Global Technical Escalation Engineer / Bangkok Based
Who we are:
Agoda is Asia's leading and fastest growing online hotel reservation website. Maintaining this position requires an incredible amount of data, a superior IT infrastructure, and world class talent to bring it all together. Information Technology is Agoda's core competence, and an IT career with us provides excellent growth opportunities in an exciting, multicultural environment with over 74 nationalities.
This position sits within a fast-paced environment, where innovation and creative thinking matter; where passion for new technology applied in creative ways drives us to constantly improve customer experience. We strive to create products and services that make a difference, and work hard to ensure continuous, consistent progress. And we never forget to have fun while doing it.
What we need:
For our team in Bangkok, we are looking for candidates with experience in supporting and managing Desktop and IT Infrastructure.
Support Responsibilities:
Escalation point for 1st level and 2nd level teams
Provide in-depth 3rd level hardware and software troubleshooting, ie BSOD (Blue Screen) and Driver issues.
Escalating and working with other teams/vendors as necessary
Manage devices via Enterprise systems management.

title: Senior Closer
description:

Buscamos um Closer Sênior para atuar como responsável estratégico pelo fechamento de negócios, elevando o nível de performance comercial da companhia.
Esse profissional receberá oportunidades altamente qualificadas pelo time de SDRs e será responsável por conduzir todo o processo de negociação até o fechamento, atuando de forma consultiva, estratégica e orientada a resultados. O foco principal da posição é maximizar conversão, ticket médio e geração de receita, especialmente em contas de maior complexidade e valor.
Responsabilidades por Resultados:
• Conduzir negociações complexas com clientes estratégicos e contas de grande porte, atuando de forma consultiva e orientada a soluções;
• Elevar as taxas de conversão e o ticket médio, utilizando estratégias de up-sell e cross-sell;
• Gerenciar o pipeline de oportunidades com foco em previsibilidade, eficiência e fechamento;
• Monitorar, analisar e reportar KPIs de fechamento, identificando gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria no processo comercial;
• Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de Customer Success, garantindo uma transição eficiente no pós-venda e contribuindo para retenção e expansão de receita;
• Atuar como referência técnica e comportamental, apoiando o desenvolvimento de SDRs e Closers juniores.

• Domínio avançado de CRM e ferramentas de automação de vendas, com capacidade de estruturar e otimizar fluxos e automações;

• Conhecimento em técnicas de storytelling, persuasão e personalização, construindo propostas de valor claras e convincentes;
• Experiência com ferramentas de comunicação e videoconferência para negociações remotas e apresentações comerciais;
Requisitos:
• Disponibilidade para viagens;
• Vivência ou experiência com o mercado financeiro.
• Experiência mínima de 5 anos em vendas e fechamento, com histórico comprovado em contas de alto valor;
• Perfil de liderança, com habilidade para atuar como mentor e ponto de referência para profissionais mais juniores;
• Certificações em técnicas avançadas de vendas, negociação ou metodologias comerciais serão consideradas diferencial;
• Forte capacidade de construção e gestão de relacionamento com decisores e clientes estratégicos;

title: Relocate to Malta Azure Cloud Solution Architect
description:
Our client's Microsoft Business Solutions team is a Microsoft Gold Partner and leader in Microsoft software implementations for medium to large organisations, providing their clients with the ability to keep up with the ever-changing digital world by implementing Microsoft's Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Customer Engagement (CE) software from the Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) software line.

Role Overview

Our client possesses extensive knowledge and expertise in various areas, enabling them to provide integrated end-to-end solutions. Their offerings are based on the Microsoft Azure and Dynamics range of products, allowing them to deliver powerful, adaptable cloud solutions. These systems are strategic IT solutions designed to integrate all management information across an entire organization into a single, intuitive software application.

The Solution Architect is responsible for creating and delivering innovative solutions for our client's customers. This individual must be comfortable working in an agile environment and capable of identifying opportunities for the Azure practice, both within the organization and in customer environments. They should be skilled at presenting Azure services and solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences, effectively communicating the business benefits, with the ultimate goal of driving growth for the Azure practice.

Job Type: Full Time

Work Place: Onsite

Location: Malta, Europe (Relocate to Malta)

Relocation: VISA & Relocation Package Included

Requirements

  • Proven experience with Azure IaaS (networking, storage, virtual machines).
  • Proven experience with Azure Backup & Recovery Services.
  • Proven experience with Azure Governance (Blueprints, policies, tagging, cost management).
  • Proven experience with Azure SQL (Managed Instances & PaaS).
  • Proven experience with Azure Security (NSG,ASG Sentinel, Security Centre, Defender, ACL, Azure Firewall, Policy).
  • Proven experience with Azure Serverless and integration (Batch, Function\Logic Apps, EventGrid).
  • Proven experience with Azure ACR, ACI, Kubernetes.
  • Proven experience with Azure AD including on premises Active Directory.
  • Experience with Windows Server\Linux OS
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (ARM\Terraform\PowerShell).
  • Experience with Microsoft 365, migrations and security.
  • Datacentre transformation experience – migration of applications, virtual machines and databases.
  • Experience leading client engagements and managing technical teams.
  • Experience or knowledge of how to modernise applications and processes using the Azure platform and technologies.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to influence and manage a range of relationships in a complex environment.
  • Strong communication skills (verbal, written and listening): an ability to present information concisely, to communicate in a manner applicable to all levels.
  • Able to produce high quality and professional presentations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to ensure documents are consistent in language, terminology and style.
  • Flexible approach to work with a focus on delivery to deadlines and high standards.
  • Ability to handle highly confidential information with tact and discretion.

Responsibilities

  • Work with clients on their Microsoft cloud adoption strategy.
  • Creating high level architectural designs based on customer requirements.
  • Deliver product presentations and configured demonstrations to prove our ability to meet a prospect's cloud adoption needs.
  • Act as the Technical Design Authority on projects alongside the Technical Architects.
  • Provide governance to projects and mentor members of the team.
  • Showcase our propositions to customers via online webinars and face to face workshops.
  • Engage with our clients stakeholders and ensure our solutions are understood throughout the firm.
  • Engage with customers on a long-term basis and drive Microsoft Azure adoption.
  • Create collateral and GTM ideas to enhance our offering in the marketplace.
  • Work on proposals and RFI's alongside the sales and pre-sales teams.
  • Maintaining technical knowledge by working closely with our Microsoft account teams.
  • The Employee is required to follow our clients Information Security Policies (ISP and ISMP) at all times.

Microsoft Business Solutions Overview

Your long-term future is every bit as important to our client as it is to you. That's why their aim is to give you experiences that will stay with you for a lifetime. Whether it's great training and development, mobility opportunities or corporate responsibility volunteering activities – you'll gain a wealth of experiences on which to build a rewarding career. Our client is a firm that encourages you to be yourself, values your contribution, and inspires you to act as a role model, always focused on doing the right thing for each other, their clients, and their communities.

This sets out all the different ways you'll be rewarded at the firm. Among other things, you can benefit from honest conversations about your career as well as a range of other rewards. In all these ways and more, they have created an environment that can bring out the best in you.

#Bethechange and #makethechange. Join our client's talented, successful team and make the leap into the future.

Don't worry, our client knows that relocation can be a challenge, which is why they have an extremely supportive onboarding team to help you throughout this process - They provide relocation support for you and your family. Our client is looking forward to meeting you and seeing you grow.

title: Tax Analyst
description:
What will you be doing?
O Analista Fiscal de Impostos Indiretos é responsável por garantir a correta apuração, recolhimento e cumprimento das obrigações acessórias relacionadas aos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, ISS, PIS, COFINS), assegurando conformidade com a legislação vigente e alinhamento aos procedimentos internos da empresa
What experience would we like you to have?
Apuração de Tributos Indiretos: Realizar cálculos e conferência de ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, ISS, PIS e COFINS, garantindo a correta aplicação das alíquotas e regras fiscais.
Obrigações Acessórias: Elaborar, revisar e transmitir SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, GIA, DAPI, SINTEGRA, entre outras obrigações estaduais e municipais, dentro dos prazos legais.
Classificação Fiscal: Validar NCM, CST, CFOP e demais códigos fiscais aplicáveis às operações, assegurando correta tributação.
Conciliação Contábil e Fiscal: Efetuar conciliações entre os valores apurados e os registros contábeis, garantindo integridade das informações.
Gestão de Créditos e Débitos: Controlar créditos de ICMS, PIS/COFINS e regimes especiais, assegurando aproveitamento conforme legislação.
Suporte a Auditorias e Fiscalizações: Preparar documentação e relatórios para atender auditorias externas e fiscalizações, fornecendo informações precisas e tempestivas.
Análise de Operações: Avaliar operações de compra, venda, transferência e serviços, identificando riscos fiscais e propondo soluções para mitigá-los.
Atualização Legal: Monitorar alterações na legislação tributária e implementar ajustes necessários nos processos internos.
Formação
Bacharel de Ciências Contábeis / Administração / Direito Cursos e conhecimentos específicos.
Necessário Inglês Intermediário (Avançado será um diferencial)
Valorizamos a diversidade e vemos as diferenças como oportunidades ao invés de barreiras, assegurando condições de pleno desenvolvimento dos nossos profissionais e, também, para a sociedade.
Todas as nossas vagas são elegíveis para pessoas com deficiência e/ou reabilitadas*

title: Coordenador de Engenharia de Dados
description:
Descrição da vaga
Estamos em busca de pessoas apaixonadas por educação e tecnologia
Queremos que você saiba atuar em um ambiente que exige a união de múltiplas competências e experiências e com foco no resultado para deixarmos nosso legado no mundo.
Se você, assim como nós, tem paixão por educação e tecnologia, o UOL EdTech é para você
Confira essa oportunidade e vem ser #EdTecher
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Liderar e desenvolver o time de analytics enginnering, atuando de forma próxima e técnica.
Atuar de forma colaborativa com times de produto, engenharia, negócios e CS/Suporte.
Explorar oportunidades de geração de valor e coordenar produtos de dados que entreguem valor ao negócio.
Planejar, priorizar e acompanhar entregas de produtos como modelos, dashboards e análises.
Atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards embedados na aplicação e relatórios internos de negócio.
Garantir a qualidade, confiabilidade e evolução dos modelos de dados, métrica, indicadores e fonte da verdade.
Implementar e monitorar a qualidade dos dados.
Requisitos e qualificações
Formação superior em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Matemática, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência prévia em gestão de pessoas em times de dados com aplicação de feedbacks, apoiando o desenvolvimento individual, acompanhamento de performance e organização do trabalho (ritmo, rituais, alinhamento).
Vivência sólida em Analytics Engineering (Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, pipelines ELT/ETL e modelagem dimensional).
Experiência prática com Power BI (incluindo Embedded) e Looker Platform / LookML.
Domínio de SQL e Python, com boas práticas de programação (desejável PySpark).
Experiência com dbt e Cloud Functions.
Vivência com BigQuery, Athena e/ou Azure Synapse Analytics.
Experiência com Git e CI/CD aplicados a pipelines, dashboards e relatórios.
Conhecimento em bancos relacionais e NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firestore).
Experiência em nuvem, com atuação sólida em AWS, GCP ou Azure (multi-cloud é diferencial).
Informações adicionais
Para se destacar nessa posição, seria legal se você também tivesse:
Experiência em ambientes B2B e interação com clientes.
Vivência em projetos multi-cloud e/ou migração entre nuvens (ex.: Azure → AWS).
Experiência com FinOps e otimização de custos em nuvem.
VAMOS TRANSFORMAR VIDAS COM EDUCAÇÃO POR MEIO DA TECNOLOGIA?
Somos uma empresa que transforma vidas com educação por meio da tecnologia oferecendo um ecossistema completo com soluções para estudantes, instituições de ensino e empresas.
Trabalhamos duro para oferecer a melhor experiência de aprendizagem digital contribuindo para remover obstáculos, ampliando o acesso à uma educação de qualidade e deixando nosso legado no mundo.
O UOL EdTech faz parte do Grupo UOL, uma empresa 100% brasileira e que revoluciona o universo digital desde 1996 e desse legado, carregamos a credibilidade, o pioneirismo e a inovação em nosso DNA.
Conheça nosso ecossistema
Oferecemos um ecossistema completo para educação que transforma vidas Nossas verticais de negócio são:
Para Estudantes: oferecemos a maior plataforma de estudos online, facilitando diariamente o acesso ao conhecimento, empoderamento e transformando o futuro das pessoas. No Brasil, utilizamos a marca Passei Direto e no restante do mundo a marca Studenta.
Para Empresas: temos duas frentes de atuação, com a Learning.Rocks oferecemos uma solução completa para atender as necessidades de treinamento das empresas, unindo tecnologia e conteúdo multiformatos. Já com a Qulture.Rocks apoiamos empresas a destravarem o potencial dos seus times, com uma plataforma de gestão de pessoas e desempenho.
Para Instituições de Ensino: somos o parceiro tecnológico de grandes universidades nas ofertas de cursos de especialização 100% online, captando estudantes no Brasil e no mundo.
Somos apaixonados por educação e tecnologia
A tecnologia é nosso combustível estamos sempre em busca de soluções disruptivas e tecnológicas que nos ajudem a romper barreiras para levar nossas soluções em educação para qualquer canto do mundo
O coletivo é mais forte que o indivíduo
Estamos sempre em busca do melhor resultado, mesmo que tenhamos que mudar a rota. Estamos na jornada de longo prazo, criando um negócio perene e de alto impacto. Somos #EdTechers e esse é o nosso jeito de ser e fazer
Nossas diferenças se somam para fazer valer nosso propósito
Acreditamos na diversidade e pluralidade das pessoas para atingir resultados incríveis Por isso, não fazemos distinção de pessoas com deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual/afetiva, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar e estética.
Conheça os benefícios de ser #EdTecher
Você terá um pacote de completo de benefícios que fazem toda a diferença:
Vale-alimentação e/ou refeição.
Plano de saúde e odontológico.
Seguro de vida.
Parceria com TotalPass e ZenKlub.
Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas.
Auxílio-creche.
Descontos de até 50% em pós-graduação e MBA de grandes instituições, como FIA, FAAP e PUCRS.
E Tem Mais, Dá Uma Olhada
No dress code: o importante é você usar o que te faz bem.
#TáDeParabéns: Day off no aniversário.
Baby gift: presente para recém-nascidos.
Saiba como funciona nosso processo seletivo
Nem todos os processos seguem o mesmo formato. Mas, a grande maioria segue um andamento parecido:

Temos uma dica importante para você
Capriche nas etapas do processo, principalmente no momento da inscrição Buscamos analisar todas as candidaturas e isso pode levar algum tempo. Por isso, caso esteja se perguntando sobre o prazo para fazermos contato, pedimos sua empatia. Todas as pessoas que se candidatam às nossas vagas recebem um retorno por meio da Gupy, seja ele positivo ou negativo. Pedimos que acompanhe sua candidatura por aqui e na sua caixa e-mail, sem esquecer de olhar o spam, combinado?
E aí, vamos transformar vidas com educação por meio da tecnologia?
Vem ser #EdTecher

title: Human Resources Administrator
description:
• Located in Barra da Tijuca, Brazil
  • Full Time Position, Monday – Friday 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.

The Company

Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification to data storage and organization, to marketing data online, our specialized data services cater for small enterprises, through to large multinational and corporate data centers. KDM's web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment have enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities.

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

The Human Resources Administrator provides day-to-day administrative and operational support across core Human Resources functions in Brazil, ensuring compliance with Brazilian labor legislation (CLT), applicable collective bargaining agreements, and internal company policies. This role supports employee lifecycle processes including onboarding/offboarding, employee record maintenance, benefits administration support, recruitment coordination, HR reporting, and employee inquiry response. The HR Administrator handles confidential employee information in accordance with the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD) and maintains accurate documentation required for audits and statutory reporting.

Tasks:

  • Support the end-to-end onboarding and offboarding process, including collection and validation of mandatory personal documents, coordination of pre-employment medical examinations (ASO), and preparation/maintenance of employment documentation.
  • Maintain accurate physical and digital employee personnel files (contracts, amendments, acknowledgements, and supporting documentation) and ensure records are up to date.
  • Coordinate HR data entry, updates, and reporting in HRIS (e.g., ADP WorkforceNow or local systems) and support required submissions and recordkeeping for Brazil (e.g., eSocial data coordination as applicable).
  • Provide administrative support for benefits and statutory programs, responding to employee questions regarding benefits and leave (e.g., vacation scheduling, meal/transportation vouchers where applicable) and routing complex items to HR leadership or vendors.
  • Coordinate recruitment administration, including job postings support, interview scheduling, candidate communications, and onboarding logistics.
  • Support compliance activities by tracking key dates and documents (e.g., probationary period checkpoints, contract renewals for fixed-term hires, and required acknowledgements).
  • Assist with internal HR communications and policy administration, including distribution of policies, collection of employee acknowledgements, and maintaining policy records.
  • Partner with local stakeholders (e.g., accounting/payroll providers) to support timely processing by providing accurate employee data and documentation, while maintaining confidentiality and data privacy controls.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of HR administrative processes, templates, and checklists to increase accuracy, speed, and compliance readiness.

Compliance and Data Privacy (Brazil): 

  • Work is performed in alignment with CLT requirements and any applicable collective bargaining agreements, including proper documentation of the employment relationship.
  • Maintain confidentiality and process personal data in accordance with LGPD principles (purpose limitation, necessity, security, and accountability).
  • Support accurate recordkeeping needed for statutory obligations and inspections, escalating questions to HR leadership or legal counsel as appropriate.

Skills and Knowledge: 

  • Working knowledge of core HR administration practices and familiarity with Brazilian Labor concepts (CLT) and HR documentation standards.
  • High attention to detail, strong organization, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Professional communication skills: English proficiency (written and verbal) required.
  • Discretion and integrity when handling confidential employee information and sensitive issues.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and comfort learning HRIS/payroll portals.
  • Strong customer-service orientation and ability to work collaboratively with employees and cross-functional partners.

Supervisory Responsibilities:  

This position has no supervisory responsibilities; however, it provides administrative support and guidance to employees on HR processes and directs questions to appropriate stakeholders when needed.

title: Mecânico de Refrigeração
description:
Indústria contrata: Mecânico de Refrigeração

  • Tipo de contrato: Contrato de trabalho temporário
  • Modelo de trabalho: Presencial
  • Horário de trabalho: Seg à Sexta de 07h às 17h, sábados alternados de 07h às 14h

Resumo:


Realizar manutenções preventivas, corretivas e preditivas em sistemas de refrigeração, climatização e HVAC, incluindo testes, ajustes, lubrificação, monitoramento e correção de anomalias para garantir o adequado funcionamento dos equipamentos.

Responsabilidades:

  • Cálculo de Carga Térmica: Avaliar o ambiente de instalação, dimensionar o local, identificar fontes de calor e especificar a capacidade do equipamento de ventilação ou refrigeração.
  • Especificação de Materiais e Acessórios: Definir tipo, modelo e tensão do equipamento, analisar projeto de instalação, avaliar local de instalação e requisitar materiais.
  • Instalação de Equipamentos: Selecionar ferramentas e equipamentos, medir o local de instalação, interpretar normas e procedimentos, instalar tubulações e drenos, interligar unidades evaporadoras e condensadoras e efetuar instalações elétricas.
  • Instalação de Ramais de Dutos: Marcar posições, confeccionar peças, montar e fixar dutos, acoplar juntas elásticas de vibração e registros de regulagem de ar.
  • Montagem de Tubulações de Refrigeração: Estabelecer percurso, dimensionar comprimentos, nivelar e fixar tubulações, efetuar pré-limpeza e pressurizar tubulações.
  • Aplicação de Vácuo: Despressurizar o sistema, conectar bomba de vácuo, instalar vacuômetro e monitorar pressão do vácuo.
  • Carga de Fluido Refrigerante: Conectar manômetros, cilindro de fluido refrigerante, expurgar o ar da mangueira e controlar a pressão do fluido refrigerante.
  • Testes nos Sistemas de Refrigeração: Verificar condições de alimentação elétrica, acionar equipamentos, controlar variáveis do sistema e monitorar funcionamento dos dispositivos de proteção e controle.
  • Checklist em Sistema de HVAC: Monitorar parâmetros de funcionamento do equipamento Chiller, unidades de tratamento de ar e realizar reparos quando necessário.
  • Execução de Tarefas Adicionais: Executar outras tarefas de mesma natureza e nível de complexidade associadas ao ambiente organizacional.
  • Monitoramento de Pressões, Temperatura e Umidade: Monitorar pressões, temperatura e umidade em salas classificadas e áreas de pesagem e amostragem.

Escolaridade:

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Técnico em Refrigeração;

Competências Técnicas:

  • Experiência prévia na área;
  • Desejável conhecimentos técnicos em Mecânica / Refrigeração / Elétrica.
  • Vivência em indústrias farmacêuticas, cosméticas ou alimentícias será considerada um diferencial.

Benefícios:

  • Refeição no local;
  • Vale transporte;

description:
FAÇA PARTE DE UMA EMPRESA COM FOCO EM SAÚDE E BEM-ESTAR
Os valores éticos e de responsabilidade social são importantes para você? Para nós também.
Quer agir em prol da saúde e do bem-estar das pessoas? É o que fazemos.
Gosta de ambientes estimulantes baseados na inovação? Desafio é o nosso lema.
Fazer parte do Grupo Pierre Fabre significa entrar numa empresa com uma história rica em valor, inovação e experiência com pacientes e consumidores. Uma empresa disposta a enfrentar os desafios do amanhã com você.
Vaga: Pessoa Estagiária de Supply Chain
Localidade: Rio de Janeiro, RJ
Resumo da vaga:
Estamos procurando alguém motivado, criativo e com vontade de trazer novas ideias para entrar no nosso time de Supply Chain da Pierre Fabre Brasil.É uma ótima oportunidade de ganhar experiência nas áreas de Supply (S&OP/Customer Service/Distribuição Física) em uma grande empresa global de dermocosméticos.
Principais atividades:
Apoiar no mapeamento e desenvolvimento de projetos de melhoria contínua nas áreas de Supply;
Automatizar e otimizar bases de indicadores, garantindo maior eficiência nos processos;
Suporte em criar e manter dashboards e relatórios gerenciais para acompanhamento dos principais KPIs;
Contribuir para a gestão de mudanças e manutenção das informações da área;
Participar da preparação e apresentação de análises para suporte à tomada de decisão;
Apoiar nas rotinas do dia a dia, sempre com foco em agregar valor e propor soluções;
Colaborar entre as áreas de S&OP, Customer Service e Distribuição física.
Um pouco do que oferecemos:
Bolsa estágio;
Vale Transporte;
Vale Refeição;
Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
Wellhub;
Seguro de Vida.
O que esperamos de você:
Curso superior em andamento em Administração, Engenharias ou cursos de ciências exatas;
Boas habilidades com o Excel e Power BI (nível avançado é um diferencial);
Inglês intermediário/avançado é um diferencial.
Perfil analítico e voltado para a solução de problemas;
Habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal;
Atitude proativa com forte vontade de aprender e tomar iniciativas.
Quem nós somos
O Grupo Pierre Fabre tem mais de 60 anos de experiência farmacêutica e foi inventor da dermocosmética. Pioneiro no cenário industrial francês graças a sua estrutura acionária única: 86% das ações são mantidas por uma fundação de mesmo nome reconhecida como de interesse público pelo governo, enquanto o restante são propriedades de seus próprios funcionários.
Temos orgulho em ser:
O segundo maior laboratório de dermocosméticos do mundo.
O segundo maior grupo farmacêutico privado francês.
Comprometidos em fazer produtos com Conscious Care: priorizando a eficácia, segurança e naturalidade nas fórmulas.
Como é trabalhar na Pierre Fabre Brasil
No Brasil, somos mais de 450 colaboradores distribuídos por todo o país. Somos conhecidos pelas nossas três marcas de consumo: Eau Thermale Avène, Darrow e Ducray. Em 2022, fomos reconhecidos entre os melhores empregadores do mundo, pela revista Forbes, e como um ótimo lugar para se trabalhar, pela GPTW.
O Grupo Pierre Fabre é, antes de tudo, uma aventura humana. Cada colaborador partilha os mesmos valores, humanistas e autênticos, são esses:
ABRAÇAR A CAUSA do Grupo, aplicando e reforçando sua estratégia.
Buscar por sua melhor PERFORMANCE.
AGIR COMO UM, ao colaborar dentro e fora de sua equipe.
CRESCER A CADA DIA, sempre aprendendo ou desenvolvendo sua equipe.
INOVAR, trazendo soluções criativas em benefício de nossos clientes.
Construir objetivos AMBICIOSO e superar resultados.
Oferecer FEEDBACK construtivo para o sucesso coletivo da equipe e da empresa.
Ao se candidatar a esta vaga você está ciente que será necessário o fornecimento de algumas informações pessoais a seu respeito ("dados pessoais") à empresa para possibilitar sua identificação no processo seletivo, bem como para que a referida empresa possa entrar em contato com você.
A empresa não compartilhará seus dados pessoais com terceiros sem a sua autorização, a menos que seja legalmente obrigada a fazê-lo, e seus dados pessoais permanecerão armazenados pelo período máximo de 2 anos a contar da data de fornecimento, ou da última atualização de sua candidatura à vaga.
Caso você seja contratado, estes dados poderão ser armazenados por um período maior em decorrência da elaboração e execução do contrato de trabalho.
Para maiores informações sobre como é feito o tratamento de seus dados PESSOAIS, bem como seus direitos enquanto titular de dados, você pode enviar uma solicitação ao Encarregado, da Pierre Fabre.
Estamos convencidos de que a diversidade é uma fonte de realização, equilíbrio social e complementaridade para nossos funcionários, razão pela qual nossas ofertas estão abertas a todos, sem restrições.

title: Regional Partnerships Lead – Community-Led Tourism
description:
At Packed, we are building a decolonial, abolitionist alternative to mass tourism. Our mission is to reconnect travelers with local communities, protect culture from commodification, and ensure tourism uplifts rather than exploits.
We are looking for Regional Managers to join our growing global network. This role is not for those who see tourism as entertainment, but for those who understand its history of extraction in the Global South and want to transform it into a tool of repair and solidarity.
What you'll do:
Map and reach out to hostels, hotels, and guesthouses in your region.
Invite them to apply to become PACKED-certified accommodations.
Explain the benefits: certified partners are recommended to travelers and receive 5% of every experience booked through their unique code.
Build and maintain respectful relationships with local hosts, ensuring their voices remain central.
How it works:
Once an accommodation is certified, your role is complete. Your network might still get in touch with you in case they have specific demands.
From then on, you earn 10% of all experience sales in your region for as long as your contract remains active.
In other words: you work upfront to build partnerships, and in return you secure a passive, long-term income stream.
Qualifications
Required:
Strong communication skills in your local language and in English.
Availability to send and respond to emails at least once a day.
Deep love for your homeland and a genuine desire to protect your community.
Preferred:
Some knowledge of the tourism industry.
A personal history of traveling.
Why join us:
Be part of a decolonial movement that challenges mass tourism and gives power back to local communities.
Shape a new model of travel that resists exploitation and celebrates cultural integrity.
Create partnerships that generate lifelong impact and lifelong income.
This is not a traditional salaried job. It's an opportunity for those who believe in reclaiming tourism and want to grow with us - ethically, sustainably, and collectively.
If this resonates with you, apply through our website and help us make tourism a tool of justice, not exploitation.

title: Delayed Coker Visbreaker Specialist
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.
Overview:
We are seeking an experienced Delayed Coker/Visbreaker Engineering Specialist to join the Operation Engineering Solutions Department (OESD).
OESD's technical team is responsible for providing high-quality, multi-disciplinary support to Global Manufacturing operating facilities (Refineries, NGLF, and petrochemical plants) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and globally.
Your primary role is to provide in-depth process engineering and operations expertise to monitor, optimize, and drive performance improvement programs for refineries' delayed Coker and visbreaker, including both remote and on-site technical advisory support, benchmarking, and technology knowledge management
Key Responsibilities:
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Conduct comprehensive performance reviews of existing delayed coker/visbreaker facilities, and analyze KPIs related to operability, profitability, reliability, and process safety.
Develop and present quarterly benchmarking reports with actionable improvement recommendations.
Provide hands-on support in implementing performance improvement initiatives, demonstrating measurable results in closing identified gaps from quarterly benchmarking reports.
Lead benchmarking and best practices exchange workshops among Global Manufacturing facilities (wholly-owned and affiliates), and facilitate knowledge sharing and continuous improvement in delayed coker/visbreaker technologies.
Deliver on-demand remote and field technical advisory support, including troubleshooting, optimization, debottlenecking, revamp, and upgrade activities and provide detailed service reports for each support activity.
Drive performance improvement programs that enhance process safety, optimize manufacturing costs, and increase plant reliability for delayed coker/visbreaker units.
Develop and implement best practices and standards for delayed coker/visbreaker engineering and maintenance, while ensuring alignment with industry standards and regulations.
Provide expert technical support to project teams and contractors for delayed coker/visbreaker engineering and procurement activities.
Coordinate with other disciplines (process, mechanical, instrumentation, and electrical) to ensure optimal performance and integration of delayed coker/visbreaker equipment.
Conduct regular audits and inspections of delayed coker/visbreaker equipment to ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and quality regulations and standards.
Evaluate and recommend new technologies and innovations for delayed coker/visbreaker improvement and optimization.
Minimum Requirements:
You will hold a Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering or a related field. An advanced degree is preferred.
You will have a minimum of 15 years of experience across the refinery and/or petrochemical industry, with at least 10 years of hands-on experience in delayed coker/visbreaker specialty.
You will be able to optimize delayed coker/visbreaker operations, with specific examples of performance improvements achieved.
You will have comprehensive knowledge of delayed coker/visbreaker processes, equipment, and systems in refining and petrochemical industries.
You will have deep understanding of ASME Section VIII Divisions 1 & 2, ASME Section I, API-530, API-535, API-537, API-560, API-579, API-936, and NFPA standards applicable to fired equipment.
You will have Significant experience in inspection and failure analysis of delayed coker/visbreaker equipment.
You will have proficiency in basic and advanced NDE techniques related to delayed coker/visbreaker equipment.
High level of proficiency in using software tools related to delayed coker/visbreaker engineering and design, such as Aspen Hysys, ANSYS, and HTRI.
You will have knowledge of remaining life calculations for heater tubes and refractory design and repair.
You will have excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to prepare and present technical reports to various audiences.
You will also have strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.
Working environment:
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

As an Senior Operations Associate, Delta Careers, you are a core owner of program delivery and experience quality. You ensure that complex, multi-stakeholder programs run smoothly and feel seamless to students, mentors, and partners.
This is not a back-office role. You will sit at the center of program execution, working closely with mentors, program coordinators, internal teams, and external partners to deliver consistently high-quality experiences at scale.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys ownership, problem-solving, and making systems work better over time.
What You'll Be Responsible For
Program Ownership & Delivery
Own the operational execution of Delta Careers programs from start to finish.
Translate program goals into clear timelines, workflows, and day-to-day execution plans.
Ensure programs are delivered smoothly, on time, and to a high standard—even when conditions change.
Stakeholder & Relationship Management
Act as the primary operational point of contact for mentors, program coordinators, and internal stakeholders.
Build strong working relationships with mentors and partners through clear communication and reliability.
Support program coordinators with guidance, alignment, and escalation handling when needed.
Quality, Judgment & Issue Resolution
Proactively identify risks, bottlenecks, or gaps before they escalate.
Exercise sound judgment in fast-moving situations to protect student experience and program quality.
Handle escalations calmly, professionally, and with a solutions-oriented mindset.
Continuous Improvement
Capture feedback, insights, and learnings from each program cycle.
Contribute to improving systems, templates, and processes so programs become more efficient and scalable over time.
Share program highlights, testimonials, and insights with internal teams to support broader impact.
Minimum Requirements
Who This Role Is For
Experience in program operations, project management, education, or coordination-heavy roles.
Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple moving parts at once.
Clear, professional written and verbal communication.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote or distributed environment.
Ideal Attributes
High ownership mindset: you naturally take responsibility and see things through.
Strong problem-solving instincts and comfort with ambiguity.
Thoughtful, people-centered approach when working with students, mentors, and colleagues.
Interest in building systems, not just executing tasks.
Calm under pressure and confident handling complex situations.
What Success Looks Like In This Role
Programs consistently run smoothly with minimal escalations.
Students, mentors, and partners report a positive, well-supported experience.
Issues are anticipated and resolved proactively rather than reactively.
Internal teams trust you as a reliable owner of program execution.
Feedback and insights lead to visible improvements in how programs operate.
Program operations feel organized, clear, and scalable.
Why Work at Delta Institute
A fast-growing, global organization with meaningful ownership from day one.
Flexible working environment with autonomy over how you work.
Strong internal mobility, many roles are filled through internal growth.
Annual individual training budget to support your development.
A culture built on trust, feedback, and continuous improvement.

title: IT Field Support Specialist
description:
Purpose
Deliver on-site technical support to ensure uninterrupted IT operations and optimize system performance for end-users in diverse environments
Responsibilities
Provide on-site technical support to end-users, including troubleshooting hardware, software, and network issues to ensure minimal disruption to business operations.
Conduct regular maintenance and repairs as needed to optimize performance and reliability.
Install, upgrade, and configure software applications, operating systems, and utilities on end-user devices, ensuring compatibility and adherence to organizational standards.
Ensure connectivity to local area networks (LANs), wireless networks, and internet services. Troubleshoot network connectivity issues and assist with network infrastructure setup and maintenance.
Provide technical assistance and guidance to end-users on IT systems, applications, and security best practices. Educate users on self-service tools and resources to empower them to resolve common issues independently.
Maintain accurate records of support activities, including ticket logging, resolution steps, and hardware/software inventory. Document troubleshooting procedures and user guides for future reference.
Deliver excellent customer service by responding to support requests promptly, addressing user concerns with empathy and professionalism, and ensuring customer satisfaction with resolution outcomes.
Accountable for delivering high-quality on-site support services that meet or exceed end-user expectations, ensuring a positive user experience and fostering trust in IT support capabilities.
Education
A high school diploma or equivalent is required. Additional technical education or certification in information technology, computer science, or a related field is preferred.
Certifications such as CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, or Microsoft Certified Desktop Support Technician (MCDST) are preferred but not mandatory.
Proficiency in English is essential for effective communication with team members, end-users, and stakeholders.
An associate's degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field is advantageous.
Additional certifications related to IT support, such as CompTIA Security+, ITIL Foundation, or Cisco Certified Entry Networking Technician (CCENT), can enhance the candidate's profile.
Experience
Prior experience in a technical support role or customer service position is beneficial, but not required for entry-level positions.Demonstrated experience in diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and network issues for end-users in a timely and efficient manner.
Proven track record of providing excellent customer service and support, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly and effectively to non-technical users.
Hands-on experience providing on-site technical support to end-users, including hardware setup, configuration, and troubleshooting.
Experience in maintaining and repairing desktops, laptops, printers, and other hardware devices, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.
Proficiency in installing, upgrading, and configuring software applications, operating systems, and utilities on end-user devices.
Familiarity with troubleshooting network connectivity issues, including LANs, wireless networks, and internet services, to ensure uninterrupted access for end-users.
Ability to maintain accurate records of support activities, including ticket logging, resolution steps, and hardware/software inventory, ensuring transparency and accountability.
Experience in providing remote technical support to off-site users, utilizing remote access tools and techniques to troubleshoot and resolve issues efficiently.

title: técnico de suporte
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II.

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar a manutenção de microcomputadores. Instalar e configurar as impressoras locais e de rede. Instalar

sistemas operacionais Microsoft e Software para escritório Microsoft Office. Configurar Internet e e-mail e Prestar

suporte a usuários no uso da internet e outras atividades relacionadas ao suporte técnico de informática

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Médio Completo

Curso Técnico em Montagem e Manutenção de Computadores,

Curso de Hardware ou

graduação completa na área de Tecnologia da Informação.

Informações adicionais

Localidade: Santa Cruz - RJ

Escala: 12 horas de trabalho X 36 horas de descanso

Horário: 07h00 às 19h00 ou 19h00 às 07h00

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão


A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Valores

  • Profissionalismo
  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Ética

title: Head of Event Services
description:
Department: Events & Entertainment
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
The Head of Event Services shall have dual reporting to the Event Services Director in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful operational planning, management and implementation of the Accommodation, Travel, Logistics, Transport and Guest Operations projects for the FIFA Women's World Cup ("FWWC").
The Head of Event Services will work together with the Event Services Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure:
1. Drive FIFA's leadership in Event Services, encompassing the above areas.
2. Ensure suitable and efficient business models and processes for operation across multiple different events, of different scales, simultaneously, across all areas under auspice.
3. Continuously assess and propose improvements to the requirements and regulations for the services. Integrate these enhancements into the Master Project Plans and detailed budgets, ensuring stakeholder alignment and cost-effective delivery for each event within the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 project.
4. Follow the trends of the industry to be ready to anticipate changes in a responsible and timely manner.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Operational Excellence and Project Delivery:
Plan and execute projects and services, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget, while maintaining high-quality standards.
Serve as the primary point of contact for the Executive Operations Director regarding all service-related matters, representing the Director on various occasions as needed.
Develop and implement efficient project plans and procedures for all tournaments and events in collaboration with other Subdivisions, ensuring seamless execution.
Collaboration and Team Integration:
Contribute to the overall success of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027as an active member of the management team, fostering strong collaboration across FIFA27.
Ensure the Event Services department consistently delivers high-quality services to tournament project teams, positioning itself as a key service provider.
Collaborate with other departments to share responsibility for the FWWC's overall success, ensuring alignment with broader goals and objectives, and maintaining a focus on the big picture.
Stakeholder Engagement and Networking:
Cultivate close cooperation with staff members across all divisions to ensure an exceptional user experience (UX). This includes coordinating with FIFA stakeholders, local FIFA subsidiaries, stadium/venue owners, host associations, local authorities, and third-party partners to create optimal conditions.
Share relevant information within the FIFA27 and with other internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective communication and collaboration
YOUR PROFILE
Independent and Flexible: Ability to lead large teams independently in complex environments, and situations with ambiguity
Effective Communication and Trust Building: Skilled in fostering open communication and creating an environment of trust. Capable of understanding and addressing the needs and expectations of others, identifying and resolving conflicts, and delivering impactful presentations. Experienced negotiator in an international context
Client-Centric Approach: Consistently demonstrates respect and professionalism toward clients (colleagues, superiors, member associations, clubs, etc.). Clearly defines and aligns expectations, ensuring client needs are met and exceeded. Receives positive client feedback, builds strong, trusting relationships, and anticipates client needs. Maintains a flexible and innovative mindset in service delivery
Leadership and Team Development: Respected leader within the team, setting ambitious objectives and motivating staff to achieve them. Inspires collaboration and fosters a high-performance culture. Well-regarded by peers and top management, adapting goals to client needs and driving continuous improvement. Effectively manages pressure, supports team growth, and handles challenges with strong interpersonal and conflict-resolution skills
Strategic Thinking: Demonstrates the ability to assess the broader impact of organizational decisions and developments, anticipating their consequences.
Decisive Action and Risk Management: Recognizes situations that require swift, pragmatic decision-making. Takes initiative, explores various solutions, and is willing to take calculated risks. Acts promptly and decisively in response to unexpected challenges.
Planning and Resource Management: Skilled in developing detailed, chronological plans, setting priorities, and allocating resources effectively. Implements systems for tracking progress and control, and adapts plans as needed to achieve objectives. Maintains a strong focus on reporting and accountability.
Collaboration in a Multi-National Team: Leads and collaborates effectively in diverse, cross-cultural teams. Navigates cultural differences, fosters inclusivity, and ensures seamless communication across global teams, driving alignment and achieving shared goals.
A minimum sports event management experience of 5 years, ideally on an international level in the Event Services (Accommodation, Travel, Logistics, Transport and Guest Operations).
Extensive knowledge of event and sport facility operations
Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
Ability to effectively monitor organisational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
Right to work in Brazil.
Fluent in English (spoken and written)
Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro soon.

title: Professor(a) de História
description:
O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.
Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.
Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.
RESUMO DAS FUNÇÕES
A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.
Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.
Procuramos um(a) Professor(a) de História para o Fundamental 2. Deve ser uma pessoa com paixão por educação e pelo universo dinâmico da escola, que tenha experiência em escola regular ou bilíngue com planejamento e execução de aulas dessa disciplina.
RESPONSABILIDADES
O que você fará:
Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;
Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos;
Ministrar aulas de História alinhadas com currículo IB, com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).
Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.
REQUISITOS
O que você precisa ter:
Diploma de Licenciatura em História;
Experiência com Fundamental 2.
Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:
Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe;
Paixão pela profissão;
Adaptar seu estilo de ensino incorporando feedbacks;
Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.
Será um diferencial se você tiver:
Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
Espírito colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time;
Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída;
Inglês.
O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

title: Sr Business Development Manager, Flights LATAM
description:
About The Job
As a Business Development Manager, Airline Partnerships, you will support and grow relationships with a portfolio of airline distribution partners, helping to drive revenue growth and long-term collaboration.
You will represent the company in day-to-day airline partner interactions, working closely with internal teams to execute commercial initiatives, support partner needs, and contribute to enterprise growth goals. This role requires a mix of account management, sales execution, and analytical skills.
At Hopper, you can have an immediate impact in a high-growth environment. Airline sales and distribution is a specialized field, so prior experience in airline distribution (OTA, TMC, GDS, airline, etc.) is a strong plus, particularly within the LATAM market.
Successful candidates will be able to clearly communicate Hopper's value proposition and effectively position our products and capabilities to airline partners.
What Your Day-to-day Would Look Like
Support the management of a portfolio of airline accounts, contributing to growth strategies and execution plans
Track partner performance, analyze results, and help identify risks and growth opportunities
Build a strong understanding of partner business objectives and assist in developing initiatives aligned with their strategy
Identify opportunities to improve commercial relationships and collaborate with internal teams to address them
Help organize and participate in quarterly business reviews with airline partners
Partner with finance teams to support forecasting and revenue tracking for airline partnerships
Assist in developing and executing marketing initiatives and insertion orders (I/Os) with airline partners in support of growth goals
Support contract negotiations, renewals, and amendments in collaboration with senior team members
Act as a liaison between airline partners and internal teams to ensure smooth operational execution and a strong traveler experience
Develop a working knowledge of the global travel market, with a focus on airline industry dynamics.
An ideal candidate has
3–5 years of experience in sales, business development, or account management with a track record of supporting revenue growth
Prior experience in airline distribution (OTA, TMC, GDS, or airline), with exposure to or experience in the LATAM market preferred
Familiarity with commercial, cultural, and regulatory dynamics of the LATAM travel ecosystem
A positive, proactive, and self-motivated attitude
Ability to prepare and deliver clear, data-driven presentations
A collaborative, team-first mindset
Strong organizational, prioritization, and time management skills
A detail-oriented and analytical approach to problem-solving
Passion for travel, technology, and digital commerce
Foundational value-selling skills and commercial acumen
Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English & Portuguese
Perks And Benefits Of Working With Us
Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.
Carrot Cash travel stipend.
Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR-offered health, dental, life and short term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers
Very generous parental leave
Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work-from-home stipend.
Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
Open communication with management and company leadership.
Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.
More About Hopper
At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper's mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.
The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. he Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.
While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we've grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world's largest brands.
Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners' direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.
Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company's recent growth:
Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS' channels every year.
Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.
Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.
Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

title: Football Opertion Specialist
description:
By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before.  Learn more at

THE ROLE: 

Football Operations Specialists are critical to the successful delivery of Genius Sports' officiating and officiating technology services. Operating in live match environments, you will work closely with qualified match officials and Genius Sports leadership to ensure flawless execution before, during, and after each fixture.

You will be trusted to perform under pressure, apply expert knowledge of football and technology, and uphold the highest operational standards in a competition followed by millions worldwide.

Matchday Operations

  • Operate football officiating technology systems during live Brasileirão fixtures.
  • Work directly alongside match officials, supporting decision-making through accurate, timely, and clear technical execution.
  • Identify, retrieve, and present the best possible camera angles and operational outputs in real time.
  • Maintain constant situational awareness during live play, where timing and precision are critical.

Pre-Match Preparation

  • Plan and manage all pre-match operational activities, typically beginning up to three hours before kick-off.
  • Conduct comprehensive system, hardware, and software checks to ensure full readiness.
  • Verify calibration, configuration, and operational integrity in line with Genius Sports SOPs.

Performance Monitoring & Issue Escalation

  • Monitor system performance throughout the match, proactively identifying anomalies or risks.
  • Independently troubleshoot technical issues in high-pressure environments.
  • Escalate issues clearly and professionally to senior operational leadership when required.

Post-Match Duties

  • Complete detailed post-match reports aligned with Genius Sports and CBF requirements.
  • Clip and document relevant match situations to support quality assurance, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to operational feedback loops to enhance future performance.

Operational Excellence & Development

  • Apply and uphold Standard Operating Procedures consistently across all assignments.
  • Contribute to training sessions and scenario-based simulations as part of ongoing development.
  • Support the development of best practices as the partnership with CBF evolves.

What you'll bring:

    • Strong Football Knowledge: Excellent understanding of football, match dynamics, and the Laws of the Game. Prior exposure to officiating environments is highly advantageous.
    • Composure Under Pressure: Proven ability to perform in live match environments where decisions are time-critical and highly scrutinised.
    • Technical Proficiency: Confident working with technology systems, with the ability to diagnose and resolve issues independently.
    • Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to preparation, execution, and reporting.
    • Clear Communication: Professional, calm, and precise communication style, particularly under pressure.
    • Self-Motivated & Accountable: Comfortable working independently as a contractor while representing Genius Sports and CBF to the highest standard.
    • Flexibility: Willingness to work evenings, weekends, and irregular hours aligned to the Brasileirão match calendar, including travel as required.
    Language Skills: Portuguese and English required

Contract & Working Model

  • This is a contractor role, paid on a per-match fee basis, with additional paid training hours.
  • Assignments will be scheduled according to competition needs and operational readiness.
  • Contractors will be expected to meet defined performance and availability standards throughout the season.

We enjoy an 'office-first' culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location.

As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we're committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports.

One team, being brave, driving change

We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius .

title: Functional IBM Maximo Scheduler
description:
Who We Are

At Highstep Technologies, we believe people are the real edge.

Our DNA is built on five core values — Empathy, Excellence, Ownership, Integrity, and Growth Through Community.
These aren't slogans; they guide how we treat each other and how we serve our clients. We call it a values-first culture — where how we work matters just as much as what we deliver.

We show up as one team — employees, contractors, and partners — united by respect, curiosity, and follow-through. We're proud to be the kind of place where people can contribute, learn, and grow together.

Our clients include some of the largest utility and infrastructure organizations in North America — teams who trust us to modernize the systems that keep cities running.

If you find purpose in solving tough problems, bringing order to complexity, and helping organizations change for the better — you'll fit right in.

About the Role

Job Type: Contract
Work Model: Remote
Level: Mid-Level (Non-Senior)

Job Summary

We are seeking a mid-level Functional IBM Maximo Scheduler to support maintenance planning and scheduling operations. This role focuses on functional configuration, operational alignment, and Scheduler usability for planners and maintenance teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure Scheduler to support maintenance planning and execution
  • Configure and maintain:
  • Job plans
  • Preventive Maintenance schedules
  • Labor, crew, and shift structures
  • Work with planners and stakeholders to validate scheduling logic
  • Support UAT and operational readiness
  • Identify functional gaps affecting Scheduler adoption

Required Qualifications

  • Practical experience using IBM Maximo Scheduler
  • Understanding of maintenance planning and scheduling workflows
  • Experience working with planners or operations teams
  • Familiarity with Maximo MAS 8 and/or MAS 9
  • Ability to operate independently within defined requirements

Why Join Highstep

  • Be part of transformation projects that make a visible impact for major companies.
  • Collaborate with smart, respectful teammates who value precision and follow-through.
  • Grow in a culture built on learning, inclusion, and trust.
  • Earn competitive pay and have access to real opportunities for career development.
  • Enjoy the freedom to own your work — with the support of a team that has your back.
  • Many of our consultants go on to lead within our PMO, OCM, and MAS practices.

The Invitation

At Highstep, we're building more than a consulting firm — we're building a community of leaders who believe how we work is the real differentiator.

If you see yourself in this description — if you lead with empathy, take pride in your work, and want to make technology feel more human — we'd love to meet you.

Even if your background looks a little different, reach out. The right mindset matters as much as the resume.

Apply now. Let's build the future of Maximo together.

Equal Opportunity & Human Rights Statement

Highstep Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every team member feels respected, supported, and valued — regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

We believe dignity and fairness are non-negotiable. We stand against discrimination, harassment, and bias in all forms. Our hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're here to ensure every qualified candidate has an equal opportunity to succeed.

Job Type: Contract

Base Pay: From R$23,000.00 per month
